insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Nocturne is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Nocturne in 31/43 games (72%): 3 picks (1-2) and 28 bans.

insights.title: Teams respect-ban Rumble against them

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Orianna? They go Viktor
insights.text: Orianna is a G1 favorite (4/15 G1s, played by DARKWINGS). In the 22 later games where it was burned or banned, DARKWINGS went to Viktor (4/22) and Hwei (3/22).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Nocturne
insights.text: Nocturne is their first ban in 13/43 games (30%). Expect it gone before your first pick.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: G1 first pick: Orianna
insights.text: With first pick in Game 1 they took Orianna 3/7 times (43%). Overall 2-4 on it. Ban it or be ready to answer it in G1.
